chunks: Who is he who will give a goodly loan to God, which He will double for him, and for him be a splendid reward?

key_terms.قَرْضاً حَسَنًا: a goodly loan (charity given seeking God's pleasure)
key_terms.يُقْرِضُ: to give a loan or lend

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to give a 'goodly loan' to God in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of *Qard al-Hasan* (the beautiful loan), emphasizing that charitable giving is an investment in the Divine Treasury rather than a mere expenditure. Scholars highlight the 'noble recompense' (*Ajran Karima*) as a reference to the eternal reward of the Ahl al-Bayt or the specific status of the giver in the presence of God, reinforcing the spiritual merit of selfless generosity.
